# Scope & Lens

> UK-based agency growth consultancy led by Josh Fowler, near Bath. Agency new business consulting and fractional growth leadership that makes new business easier and repeatable through permissionless value. Works with agencies in the UK and anywhere else, mostly remotely.

## Who it is for
- Agency founders who still bring in most of the work themselves
- New business leads who need opportunities created on purpose, not by referral
- Agency growth teams who want one way to prospect, pitch and track growth

## Approach
- The 95-5 rule: only around 5% of B2B buyers are in market at any one time (Ehrenberg-Bass Institute for the LinkedIn B2B Institute). Scope & Lens helps agencies be quietly useful to the other 95% before a brief exists.
- Three principles: Permissionless Prospecting (value-first outreach before any brief), Strategic Storytelling (pitch transformation, not capability), Visualised Value (pitch design built to be seen, not read).

## Services
- 30-Day Growth Sprint: the whole system built across all three pillars, with unlimited pitch support.
- Fractional Growth Lead: senior new business and commercial leadership on a part-time retainer, without the senior hire.
- Pitch and Win Together: narrative, flow, design and rehearsal for must-win pitches, on a revenue share with no upfront fee.
- Growth Dashboard: one live view of pipeline, target accounts, campaign data and outreach activity, combined into a prioritised list of who to approach next.
- Free: the Permissionless Healthcheck (15 questions), the Permissionless Audit (45 minutes live), Permissionless Peers (monthly session), and two free tools.

## Track record
- £55M+ new business revenue won for agencies
- 100+ pitches delivered and supported
- 11+ years in agency new business and growth (Accenture, Dentsu, independents)
- £2.5m added to one agency's pipeline in 9 months
- 300% increase in new business for one agency
